payload.summary: Last spring a caravan vanished on the Old Trade Road.
Mira watched the guild caravan roll out of Market Square before dawn.
A frightened traveller showed Orin the strange symbol scratched on a broken crate.
Thorne logged the caravan passing the North Gate after sunrise.
Thorne realized the evening patrol never returned.
Mira told us the caravan left before dawn.
Elowen noticed Mira glancing nervously toward the North Gate.
We decided to search the Old Trade Road for the caravan.
Because of that decision, we bought supplies for the road.

payload.statement: Broken wagons and scattered crates fill this roadside clearing; it is where the guild caravan was attacked.
A wagon wheel lies broken beside the road.
The spokes were sawn through cleanly, not smashed.
A crude goblin blade lies in the grass.
The blade has never been used: no nicks, no blood.
A strange symbol is burned into a wagon plank.
The symbol was drawn with care by a practiced hand.
Heavy boot prints, too large for goblins, lead north off the road.
Some cargo was burned where it stood.
Only a few crates were burned; most of the cargo is gone.
